== Biography ==
=== 2021 Season ===
Danny's first team was the amateur organization [[Zenith Esports]], which he joined at the beginning of the season and with whom he played using the ID Dan. After strong performances in [[RCL Season 10]] and [[UPL 2020 Fall]], the entire Zenith roster was acquired by [[Evil Geniuses.NA|Evil Geniuses]] and renamed to [[Evil Geniuses Prodigies]]. At this time, Dan renamed to Shiro. The team played in the [[LCS Proving Grounds 2021 Spring]] and finished 5-6th, with Shiro being a standout performer. Although only 17 and having never played in Academy, Shiro was promoted to Evil Geniuses' LCS squad to replace [[Deftly]] for the [[LCS 2021 Summer|Summer Split]]. Upon his promotion, he renamed again, this time to Danny.

== Trivia ==
* Started playing ''League of Legends'' when he was 6 years old, first reached Challenger when he was 14, and debuted in LCS when he was 17.
* Looks up to [[Ruler]].
* Is from Honolulu, Hawaii.

=== Individual Awards ===
* LCS 1st All-Pro Team (2022 Summer)
* LCS 2nd All-Pro Team (2021 Summer)
* LCS Rookie of the Year (2021)
